faq.headline: Questions.
faq.subtext: What students ask before they apply.

extra.q: Does it stack with other discounts?
extra.a: Annnimate allows one discount per checkout, so a student code doesn't stack with regional or member pricing.

extra.q: How long does the code last?
extra.a: Each student gets one code. It works once and runs for 30 days from the day we send it, so use it at checkout before then. We may cancel a code that went to someone who isn't a current student.
